text: Did you know that if you mix pumpkin with cream cheese,
an egg, honey, or any other sweetener you like,
Whisk it all together until silky smooth.
Then bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit until set.
And you've got the creamiest pumpkin cheesecake.
And the pumpkin seasoning isn't just for flavor.
It contains cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg,
which helps digestion and can also relieve inflammation.
